structural_expansion.reason: Complexity is no longer capped by the queue boundary, but the provisional constraint retriever has only 22.8% micro precision against known queue hosts, invalidating its six deduplicated apparent high-support counts. Exact-host within-component expansion reduced 67 raw candidates to 45 unique contexts, including 13 multi-base intersections and contexts up to 23 nodes; the only two above 100 commits are punctuation insertions. No candidate can be registered before paired-rule retrieval, repository independence, semantic grounding, and MDL.

semantic_first_alignment.reason: Post-hoc alignment of globally mined structural candidates is insufficient. The Python packaging category obtains 61.9% coverage from a keyword-argument base but only 31.7% category precision, while the broad configuration category obtains 84.2% coverage from six OR clauses but only 16.8% precision. Recursive composition should therefore search category-conditioned structural context that improves held-out coverage, precision, and MDL; semantic categories remain primary when structural groupings overlap.

downward_semantic_refinement.reason: The stricter three-example child floor produced nine traceable downward splits, including Grunt versus Gulp and packaging subfamilies, while 21 eligible nodes stopped because no candidate split passed every quality gate. Labels and structural rules remain provisional pending LLM grounding, repository-independent support, and held-out validation.

centroid_meaning_grounding.reason: Competing LLM-generated noun meanings are selected using trimmed-centroid alignment and fit across every member rather than model self-confidence. The method preserves ambiguity: the 42-change packaging parent remains low confidence because two meanings nearly tie, while a geometrically strong six-change URL node abstains because its examples do not entail one shared meaning.

category_conditioned_structural_inductio.rule_form: OR of structurally constrained AND clauses
category_conditioned_structural_inductio.reason: Typed AST context frames materially improve traceability over name-invariant shapes and allow two rules to compress held-out category labels by at least 1.2x. Neither meets all precision, support, repository-independence, and final edit-script MDL gates, so registration remains empty.

paired_semgrep_evaluation.reason: Paired Semgrep prefilters plus GumTree edit verification materially improve traceability and remove false source-context matches, most dramatically reducing the Trove prefilter from 82 after-side matches to six verified true positives. The rules remain below independent-repository support and final edit-script MDL gates.

semantic_structural_feedback_loop.reason: The 20 apparent false positives were all code-grounded package setup changes, demonstrating that discovery-cluster membership was incomplete rather than that the matcher was uniformly wrong. Combining executable structural evidence, LLM entailment, and member-vector fit added 15 conservative members and materially improved held-out rule quality. The category's OR branches are atomic, so composite MDL is not applicable; registration remains blocked on external provenance, held-out semantic validation, and source-level mutation/reparse verification.

observed_provenance_support.reason: Counting each CommitPackFT row once and unioning rows that share repository names prevents known alias inflation. The resulting 101 components clear the numeric proxy, but disjoint-name forks, renamed mirrors, cherry-picks, and commit-wide scope remain invisible in the bucket.

structural_constituent_mdl.reason: Classification-label compression is not composite-pattern compression. The separate constituent code grants no MDL credit to single-atom rules and finds only one multi-atom clause above 1.2x; that clause remains below support cutoffs and the proxy does not yet encode complete GumTree edit trees.

role_aware_metamorphic_probes.reason: Randomizing local labels while preserving semantic anchors keeps every persisted-AST clause matched, while mutating the anchors themselves breaks every tested clause. The distinction is empirically supported but still needs complete source mutation and GumTree/Semgrep reparsing.

broad_component_category_layer.reason: The parent layer turns narrow traceable change meanings into broader component responsibilities without forcing every meaning into a closed taxonomy. Eight leaves abstain and one cross-cutting Webpack/server meaning receives two parents. General usefulness must now be measured against static components from held-out repositories.

repository_disjoint_static_component_tra.reason: All 11 induced parents transfer to at least one static file, while 25 explicit abstentions expose responsibilities the vocabulary does not yet cover. Five omissions recur across independent held-out files and should seed the next code-grounded clustering loop. The 68.75% rate is exploratory LLM-adjudicated coverage, not precision.

static_gap_feedback_loop.reason: Only 10 of 57 high-similarity retrievals materially implement the proposed responsibility. The audit expands string processing to seven independent files while correctly leaving four attractive labels below even the small pilot support floor. Final promotion still requires structural traceability, human calibration, and the proposal's full support cutoffs.

static_string_processing_structural_vali.reason: The category supports human-readable retrieval but the learned AST clauses cover only three of seven examples in-sample and recover no held-out positive. Broad semantic component categories must not be conflated with precise structural primitives; transformation and analysis/parsing children are the next defensible split hypotheses.

recursive_static_semantic_refinement.reason: Residual-aware recursion finds one meaning-specific child with positive fit gain and two additional code-entailing examples, but support remains below the five-file pilot floor. The larger proposed OpenAI payload requires explicit user approval, so no additional external retrieval or structural promotion occurs.

sweep_3130.reason: The verified 500-file recursion preserves a coherent four-file Text normalization child without forcing singleton meanings. Expanding external retrieval to 2,000 third-party source files requires explicit approval; otherwise the next safe route is local-only evidence collection and human calibration.
